critical_code_review_comments: Role scoping is enforced at BOTH backend (dashboard.py + admin.py raise 403 for Manager on cross-dept + admin endpoints) and frontend (Overview.tsx renders only what /overview returns; App.tsx sidebar hides Admin via isTopMgmt; Attendance.tsx uses `all = isTopMgmt(user)` to render <select> vs <Chip>; Reports.tsx wraps report list/AI-usage in `top && …`; Layout.tsx returns access-denied card when !canUseDashboard). Defense-in-depth verified end-to-end.
webdash/src/api.ts error unwrap surfaces backend detail string cleanly — Manager cross-dept 403 renders as 'Managers can only view their own department' inside a red card, not a raw JSON dump.
webdash/src/i18n.tsx uses localStorage['hogo_lang'] initializer — Marathi/Hindi persist across route changes and hard reload as verified.

webdash/src/auth.tsx rankOf/isTopMgmt/canUseDashboard/canReviewAttendance are correctly composed: worker rank>3 → dashboard denied; Manager rank=3 → dashboard allowed but not top-mgmt; TIME_OFFICE Manager gets attendance-review override (canReviewAttendance) without seeing Admin.
13 dept tiles served in a deterministic ordering; dept-tile-<CODE> testIDs match backend department.code exactly (ACCOUNTS…TIME_OFFICE).
